correctness.rationale: The substitution t(Bj+s)=t(j)+s mod m and m|B make each complete B-block exactly balanced. Sliding a B^{e+1} window from Bj to Bj+s removes/adds only two cyclic letter prefixes and gives V_e(Bj+s)=P_{s mod m}(t(j+B^e))-P_{s mod m}(t(j)). Adding B^e produces digit-sum jump 1+C_e(j) mod m, where C_e is the number of consecutive (B-1) digits from position e. For each fixed carry c, its density is (B-1)/B^{c+1}, and a higher unconstrained digit makes the initial t(j) uniform mod m. Summable carry tails B^{-K} justify natural densities along all cutoffs, yielding q_{B,m}(c) and a law independent of e. Proper cyclic intervals have distinct shifts, giving exact zero mass. Independent exact formula and finite sliding-window calculations support but do not replace the all-exponent argument.
